title: Refresh onboarding and tutorial
summary: First-run onboarding and the reusable tutorial now teach the same complete 45.x app, including the newest navigation, decision, personalisation and sharing features.
changes: Rebuilds first-use onboarding as an eight-step current-app tutorial covering identity, Night, Changes, Actions, Breaks, Team Chat, Account and Personalisation, sharing, installation and reusable help.
Updates the App Guide into a complete Tutorial & app guide with one-tap lessons for Night, Changes, Actions, Breaks, Team Chat, Full roster, Account & Personalise, sharing and update history.

Advances the education generation so existing users receive the refreshed walkthrough once, while updated Changes, Breaks and Chat tips can be rediscovered without repeating them after the full tutorial is completed.
Makes Skip for now genuinely temporary and keeps the complete tutorial replayable from Account, while preserving clock-change guidance, roster logic, staffing rules and shared-data behaviour.
